preconditions.description: Number of cities (n) and number of roads (m) are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The number of separate cities is a non-negative integer not greater than the number of cities.
The output is the minimum number of separate cities after the reform.
